title: Pictures with Santa
seo_title: Pictures with Santa in Phillipsburg, MO – Dec 19, 2026
description: Pictures with Santa Claus is a holiday event at RV Repair Near Me where you can get your photo taken with Santa, plus enjoy hot chocolate, crafts, door prizes, and flash deals. Guests are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy to donate to the holiday toy drive. It takes place Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11 AM to 3 PM at 18256 Campground Rd. in Phillipsburg, MO.
